title: Fall Women's Yoga Retreat on Cape Cod
description: Slow down this fall with a day of yoga, meditation, journaling, and connection in beautiful Falmouth, MA.
long_description:
Slow down this fall with a day of yoga, meditation, journaling, and connection in beautiful Falmouth, MA.

About this Event

You're invited to this day-long women's wellness retreat in Falmouth, MA. Join a group of like-minded women to embrace the season of letting go, gratitude, and inner reflection. Together, we'll ground into our bodies, our breath, and our soul while creating space to release what no longer serves us and reconnect with what matters most.
Step away from the busyness of daily life and into a nourishing day of yoga, meditation, journaling, breathwork, group connection, reiki, and sound healing. Enjoy a delicious seasonal lunch, afternoon tea, and a thoughtfully curated gift bag featuring goodies from local Cape Cod businesses.
This retreat is a celebration of fall and is open to all women. Whether it's your first retreat or your tenth, whether you're coming alone or with friends, whether you're new to yoga or have been practicing for years - this retreat is for YOU. You are welcome here, exactly as you are. I hope you'll join us.
Full details can be viewed on intheyogaflow.com/fall-yoga-retreat-cape-cod
